# Goroutines

A goroutine is a lightweight thread managed by the Go runtime. Start one with the go keyword. Goroutines are multiplexed onto a small number of OS threads by the scheduler.

# Channels

Channels are typed conduits that let goroutines communicate. An unbuffered channel blocks the sender until a receiver is ready. Use select to wait on multiple channel operations.

# Cancellation with context

The context package carries deadlines, cancellation signals and request-scoped values across API boundaries. Always pass ctx as the first argument and check ctx.Err() in long loops.

# pgvector

pgvector adds a vector column type to PostgreSQL. Create an HNSW index with vector_cosine_ops for approximate nearest neighbour search, and query with the <=> cosine distance operator.

# MongoDB Atlas Vector Search

Atlas Vector Search uses the $vectorSearch aggregation stage. Define a vector search index with numDimensions and similarity, then set numCandidates to 10-20 times the limit for good recall.

# BM25

BM25 is a keyword ranking function. It scores documents by term frequency with saturation (k1) and document length normalisation (b), weighted by inverse document frequency.

# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF combines several ranked lists by summing 1/(k + rank) for each document. It ignores raw scores, so it can fuse cosine similarity and BM25 without calibration. The usual constant is k = 60.

# Chunking

Split documents into chunks before embedding. Fixed-size windows with overlap are simple; heading-aware markdown splitting keeps sections together and preserves the section path as metadata.

# Embeddings

An embedding model maps text to a dense vector so that similar meanings are close under cosine similarity. text-embedding-3-small produces 1536 dimensions and supports shortened vectors.

# Rate limits

When the embeddings API returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, back off exponentially and honour the Retry-After header. Batch inputs to reduce request count.

# Troubleshooting ECONNRESET

The error ECONNRESET means the remote peer reset the TCP connection. Check idle timeouts on load balancers and enable HTTP keep-alive tuning.

# Evaluating retrieval

Measure retrieval with recall@k, the share of relevant documents found in the top k, and MRR, the mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant result. Keep a labelled query set in version control.
